name: Field / entity extraction
description: Extract structured fields from an order email: which product line it concerns and whether a promo/voucher code is present. Labeled with the true values.

product_category.instructions: Which product line does this message concern?

criteria.hardware: Physical devices sold by the company
criteria.other: Cannot be determined or fits no product line

has_promo_code.instructions: The message contains a promo, discount, or voucher code.

criteria.true: A code like PROMO20, SAVE-10, or similar is present
